name: GitLab work item refiner
description: Refine labelled GitLab issues after scheduled scans or signed webhook events by posting open questions, recommendations, and requirements gaps.

gitlab.message: Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN with api scope to read issues and post notes. MCP-only access is not supported.

exampleImplementation: Scan open, labelled GitLab issue-type work items on a schedule, or respond to signed issue webhooks by rechecking the live issue and label event. Read the description and human discussion and post one refinement note per label application with open questions, recommendations, and gaps.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to check for labelled GitLab issues.

source.label: Signed GitLab webhook source
source.help: Register a custom GitLab webhook source with standard_webhooks signing first, then select it here. Configure GitLab 19.0+ issue events with its signing token; see the skill README.

on.label: GitLab events
on.help: Respond to issue open, reopen and label-change updates; live state and label event ID are checked before refining.

projects.label: Projects
projects.help: GitLab projects whose issues need refinement. Subgroups are supported.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Apply this label to an open issue to request refinement.

gitlabApiUrl.label: GitLab API URL
gitlabApiUrl.help: HTTPS /api/v4 root of the instance. Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN; MCP-only access is not supported.

setup.message: This deployment cannot run the bundled refiner directly. Configure scheduled polling, or first ask the user to register a signed GitLab custom webhook and its issue events before selecting an event trigger.
